# awstagging_aws_ec2_snapshot (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String) AWS availability zone where the resource is being provisioned in
- `compliance` (String) Compliance level for a resource
- `compute_type` (String) Compute type for compute resources, e.g. EC2, RDS, ECS, Lambda, ...
- `cost_centre` (String) Cost centre identifier for billing AWS resources
- `custom_fqdn` (String) Custom FQDN for the resource, e.g. a Route53 alias
- `custom_name` (String) Custom name, when relying on automatically generated ones is not feasible
- `custom_name_prefix` (String) Custom name prefix, when relying on automatically generated ones is not feasible
- `custom_tags` (Map of String) Map of optional tags, in the form: 'TagName = TagValue'. Names are prefixed with custom prefix
- `custom_tags_verbatim` (Map of String) Map of optional tags, in the form: 'TagName = TagValue'. Names are used as specified, without custom prefix
- `description` (String) Free-text description for the resource being tagged
- `is_application_load_balancer` (Boolean) Is this an application or network LoadBalancerV2?
- `is_create_before_destroy` (Boolean) If we want to recycle a resource by creating a new instance before destroying the existing one, then names must be different otherwise the process will fail. We do this by appending a hashed value to a common name-prefix. This is an override flag of the resource type specific property
- `is_force_generated_name` (Boolean) Expliticly decide to ignore var.custom_name and automatically generate a new name (used to ease transition of resources with legacy names)
- `is_inbound` (Boolean) Is this an inbound or outbound Route53 resolver endpoint?
- `is_propagate_tags_at_lauch` (Boolean) Propagate tags at launch? This is for building the AWS-formatted map of tags with the 'propagate_at_launch' property (relevant only for autoscaling groups?)
- `owner` (String) Owner/maintainer of the AWS resource being tagged
- `platform_name` (String) Runtime ID a resource is running, e.g. Linux, Windows, Python, Nodejs... Useful for naming AGS, Lambda functions, Launch Templates, ...
- `region` (String) AWS region where the resource is being provisioned in
- `role` (String) Role played by AWS resource in the context of its environment, e.g. database, security, ...
- `role_extend` (String) Role played by AWS resource in the context of its environment, e.g. database, security, ...
- `versioning_sources` (List of String) Values used to generate the random suffix. If not specified, the static portion of the resource name will be used

### Read-Only

- `name` (String)
- `name_hash` (String)
- `name_prefix` (String)
- `tags` (Map of String)
- `tags_as_maps` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags_as_maps))
- `type_name` (String)
- `type_prefix` (String)
